workflows.name: establish_ip_connection
workflows.description: Establish, create or provision a new IP connection (connectivity service) from a source node to a destination node with a requested bandwidth or bitrate.

steps.intent: compute the shortest route between source and destination nodes for a candidate connection
provision and bring up a new IP connection on the SDN-controlled network

workflows.name: remove_ip_connection
workflows.description: Remove, delete, tear down or release an existing IP connection between two nodes and restore isolation.

steps.intent: tear down an existing IP connection on the SDN-controlled network

workflows.name: query_connection_status
workflows.description: Show, list or check the status and state of the IP connections configured in the SDN controller.

steps.intent: retrieve the status of IP connections from the SDN controller

workflows.name: compute_route_only
workflows.description: Compute or find the shortest route or path between two nodes without provisioning anything (what-if path query).

steps.intent: compute the shortest route between source and destination nodes for a candidate connection
